purpose: Response-blind feasibility of recovering population-source coordinates from destination-garden coordinates in reciprocal transplant study when study/species/population identifiers match exactly.
original_source_contract_scope: Reuse both originals and byte-level SHA256/MD5 already pinned, never fit any biological response.

strict_source_as_garden_rule.definition: A Hargreaves source population is mapped only if that EXACT same source ID also appears as a destination garden site ID in the same original study and binomial species and that destination site has one unique finite original WGS84 coordinate. No fuzzy aliases, no study-level centroid, no midpoint, no cross-study matching.
strict_source_as_garden_rule.source_ID_and_garden_ID_handling: Strip surrounding spaces only; retain all interior punctuation and original case. Taxon use already frozen strict binomial normalization.
strict_source_as_garden_rule.garden_ambiguity: If an original garden name maps to >1 distinct coordinate or any missing/invalid coordinate row, ABSTAIN; do not infer mean.
strict_source_as_garden_rule.source_origin_validation: Independently compare recovered Hargreaves exact garden-coordinate candidates to ORIGINAL Bontrager source lat_source/long_source for exact shared (study,taxon,source ID) population keys. Do not treat same original paper or local names as independent evidence.
strict_source_as_garden_rule.calibration_group: unique original source population key, not rows/cells
strict_source_as_garden_rule.output_distances: Aggregated bins, median/p95 and maximum of valid comparable distances only, never raw coordinates.
strict_source_as_garden_rule.calibration_does_not_automatically_autho: Known-source calibration may reveal mismatches; no new macro fitness model may start from this source-only study.
